support_text: APO (100 µmol/l), a NADPH oxidase (NOX) inhibitor, decreased ROS production to a considerable extent in all analysed human sperm samples. In HRP and VHRP samples, high ROS production was not completely abolished by APO, which affected almost 75-90% of ROS generation. In LRP and NRP samples, where baseline ROS production was below 0.1 RLU, APO completely abolished ROS production. APO-induced prevention of ROS production caused cell death.
